code: C358B2A8 C358B35F (or C358B2D8 C358B35F) on slot 38
effect: Two cut World 5 stages, between 5-4 and 5-5, with their own layout
note: The Normal Game records (48 bytes from $C3:58B8, listed at $C3:5840) include two the list skips: $C3:5FA8 and $C3:5FD8, between 5-4 ($C3:5F78) and 5-5 ($C3:6008). They use World 5's graphics and a layout stream no listed stage uses ($D7:1C45): a thick ring of blocks around the pillars. With slot 38 (the filler 5-7) pointed at either, and $0092 = 38, they load and play. World 5 seems to have had 7 stages, which would explain the filler 5-7 and 5-8. Image: 5-4, the two cut stages, 5-5. English: same records and list (the patch doesn't touch $C3:5840-$C3:6037); both codes entered in Mesen's cheat engine with $0092 = 38 load the two ring-of-blocks World 5 stages.

code: C362336F C3623468, then battle with set 0
effect: An unreferenced battle stage: stage 6's arena with a striped floor and no gimmicks
note: Battle stage records (34 bytes, $C3:62DB-$C3:686E) are picked from four sets at $C4:0074. One more record follows them at $C3:686F, and nothing points to it: stage 6's start positions and background with its own layout stream ($D7:5576, between stage 6's two) and no gimmick objects. Pointing set 0, entry 0 at it ($024A = 0) loads it in Mesen. Image: retail stage 6 (left), the unreferenced record (right). Static: the English ROM has the battle records $C3:62DB-$C3:68A0, the set table $C4:0074 and the layout stream $D7:5576 byte-identical; not run in Mesen.

effect: A jingle and four sound effects the game never plays
note: Music requests ($C3:4A44) come from constants and the stage headers' byte +$15: 01-0D, 0F-19, never 0E. 0E is a short jingle of about 2.2 s with samples of its own (1E-21). Effect requests ($C3:4A7F) cover 01-04, 07-1E, 20, 22, 24-28 and 2A-30. 06 is a high sound of about 2 s, 1F a low rumble in waves of about 4.8 s, 23 two low thuds, 29 two hits. Recorded in BizHawk with the intro's music request changed to 0E and its own effects held back. Static: the English patch leaves the request routines ($C3:4A44, $C3:4A7F), the stage headers and the sound data unchanged and adds no music or effect calls, so 0E and the four effects stay unused.

code: A Super Famicom Mouse plugged in
effect: A full-screen warning that the game can't be used with the mouse or the Super Scope, with a crying girl at a TV next to Bomberman; Start doesn't get past it
note: $C1:BCDD reads each port's device ID ($1B-$1F, from the multitap read at $C0:FBD7; ports 3-5 only with a multitap) and, on any non-pad device, sets $7F:70DD/$70DE and runs the screen ($C1:BD4A -> $C4:3BC0): 「このゲームは、スーパーファミコンマウスやスーパースコープを使うことはできません。」. It is checked at boot and at five menu points. Mesen with a real SNES Mouse in port 2, no patch: the screen comes up at frame 117. English: Mesen with a SNES Mouse in port 2, no patch: $7F:70DD/$70DE = 1 by frame 120 and the same screen comes up, its text still in Japanese.
